title: Carlink car map (format 1)
description: How a car is built, for the linked parts: assemblies (members, anchors, signs, catalogue hooks), relations (L1's links plus assembly, position, body gate, prior) and chains (a second hop opened by a sign). Design: plans/2026-11-18-car-knowledge/K1-design.md. The authoritative check is app/intake/car_map.py validate() (cross-references, {side} symmetry, cycles); this file is its shape, for editors and reviewers.

version.description: Frozen version name, e.g. K1.0; goes in each link_rule as <version>:<relation id>.

from_l1.description: Set by car_map.from_l1 on a converted L1 table.

name.description: A canonical part (taxonomy.CANONICAL_PARTS, never a (side undetermined) one, never Other / Not Listed) or a name from car_map_new_names.json; {side} at the start stands for Left and Right.

body.description: Bodies this member or relation exists on; null = every body. hatch / sedan are taxonomy.body_class. An unknown body always passes.

reason.description: Plain words for the Review step; no 3+ digit number, no make or model.

hidden.description: Not visible from outside with the closures shut (default false).

strip_down.description: Only confirmable once parts come off (default false).

fitted.description: if_fitted: an option some cars lack (fog lamps, sensors, camera); shown with 'if fitted' wording.

new.description: True exactly when the part is a new name (car_map_new_names.json).

id.description: Unique in the whole map; the walk's enum value.

ask.description: A yes/no question a light vision model can judge from a photo of the damaged anchor.

level.description: The hit level a yes (with a photo) shows.

points_to.description: Relation ids (from an anchor of this assembly) a yes lifts from strip_down to likely.

unlocks.description: Chain ids (starting at an anchor of this assembly) a yes opens.

oem_diagrams.description: OEM diagram names that hold this assembly (generic words, no make).

oem_numbers.description: Diagram numbers by numbering scheme, e.g. {"scheme": ["1234"]}.

anchors.description: Members whose damage starts the assembly walk (usually the outer panel).

assembly.description: The parent's assembly: the Review step's group.

side.description: same: both names have {side}; impact: only the child; none: the child has none.

area.description: Skill file / linked-check end; default the assembly's.

position.description: Where on the parent the hit must be (from the walk's hit_at); default any.

rank.description: 1 = a surveyor lists it most often with this parent at this level.

id.description: Shares one id space with the relations.

then.description: Relation id starting at first's child: middle part -> end part. Never a chain (at most 2 hops).

min_hit.description: The anchor's hit level needed (default heavy).
